propositions: R5 amends the review_kernel verification vocabulary, which is shared with the code-review gate, risking a silent cross-gate regression.
The replay runs the amended kernel over the full code_review_adjudication.jsonl corpus and must produce a byte-identical (decision, priority, validity) diff for every finding.
The new asserted_capability_confirmed sub-answer must read na for every finding outside the G6/E4/T3 cohort.
Decision comparison uses deterministic replay of pass-2/3 math over recorded verifications, plus a ~20-finding live sanity slice to confirm the amended prompt parses.
E5 is blocked on R5 (ea39, open, not landed) because the candidate branch and asserted_capability_confirmed are absent from the codebase.
A docs/experiments writeup must record the method and outcome as input to R5's gate row.
